pr_title: fix(rust,python): sanitize column naming in boolean ops

issue_context.title: `pl.col('*') | True` doesn't override columns, but `pl.col('*') & True` does
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.

- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.


### Reproducible example

```python
import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({'a': [True, False], 'b': [False, False]})
print(df.with_columns(pl.col('*') & True))
print(df.with_columns(pl.col('*') | True))
```


### Issue description

This prints
```python
shape: (2, 2)
┌───────┬───────┐
│ a     ┆ b     │
│ ---   ┆ ---   │
│ bool  ┆ bool  │
╞═══════╪═══════╡
│ true  ┆ false │
│ false ┆ false │
└───────┴───────┘
shape: (2, 3)
┌───────┬───────┬─────────┐
│ a     ┆ b     ┆ literal │
│ ---   ┆ ---   ┆ ---     │
│ bool  ┆ bool  ┆ bool    │
╞═══════╪═══════╪═════════╡
│ true  ┆ false ┆ true    │
│ false ┆ false ┆ true    │
└───────┴───────┴─────────┘
```

### Expected behavior

```python
shape: (2, 2)
┌───────┬───────┐
│ a     ┆ b     │
│ ---   ┆ ---   │
│ bool  ┆ bool  │
╞═══════╪═══════╡
│ true  ┆ false │
│ false ┆ false │
└───────┴───────┘
shape: (2, 2)
┌──────┬──────┐
│ a    ┆ b    │
│ ---  ┆ ---  │
│ bool ┆ bool │
╞══════╪══════╡
│ true ┆ true │
│ true ┆ true │
└──────┴──────┘
```

comments: Can reproduce on the latest main.
I think it might be because the expression optimizer realizes `x | true` is just `true`? So it optimizes it to a literal? Whereas `x & true` depends on `x`.

Yep, that's it: https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/main/crates/polars-plan/src/logical_plan/optimizer/simplify_expr.rs#L152

The same occurs with `x & False`.

review_comments: Maybe we should set a `static LITERAL_NAME: str` somewhere.
Yeah this is not ideal, but when we do `rg -i literal` should pick up all cases we have hardcoded literal now.
